column1: # Curios: useless, charming loot with a line of flavor. Never required, never crafted with; kept in chests or on a
# display shelf, and the pawn shop buys them (sell=). They drop from the loot tables in loot.tsv: missions on
# turn-in, defeated enemies, bandit camps, gathering spots and festival games.

column10: use

A square-holed coin from before the Leaf printed notes
A toy ninja in flaking paint, one arm raised in a sign nobody uses
Twelve out of a hundred, and a very good drawing of a toad

A dented bronze bell that still rings true

Sand from somewhere much hotter than here
Loaded. Both of them

A scale the size of your palm
